season.text: Kaziranga usually reopens in phases from October and runs to about the end of April or May, closing for the monsoon floods. Dates are set each year by the park; check before you book.

zones.name: Central (Kohora)
zones.best_for: Rhinos, elephants, wild buffalo; the most popular range

note: Entry is about ₹100 for Indians and ₹650 for foreign nationals, plus camera fees and a per-jeep charge (roughly ₹3,000–5,500, varies by range and season). Morning slots in Central and Western fill first between December and March. There is no official night safari.
